_comment: Witness asset pipeline — STAGE 0.25 ref-refinement workflow (FLUX.2 [klein] 9B Base, FP8, img2img). Orchestrator inserts this between stage 0 (hand-picked OR Flux.1-generated ref.png) and stage 0.5 (Zero123++) when --kind is mesh|animated. Per-category denoise (__STRENGTH__): vegetation 0.60, prop/figure 0.50, structure 0.40. The ref source is uploaded to ComfyUI's input/ directory by refine_ref_image.py and referenced via __REF_FILENAME__. NODE CONTRACT (verified against ComfyUI's official FLUX.2 Klein 9B template, 2026-05): UNETLoader loads the FP8 diffusion model from diffusion_models/ (NOT unet/); CLIPLoader is single (NOT DualCLIPLoader) with type=flux2 pointing at Qwen-3 8B FP8-mixed; VAELoader uses the dedicated flux2-vae; KSampler with cfg=1.0 replaces the FLUX.1 BasicGuider+FluxGuidance+SamplerCustomAdvanced chain (FLUX.2 does not use FluxGuidance). If BFL or ComfyUI changes any of this, update both this file and tools/HUNYUAN_RUNBOOK.md §0 in lockstep.
